$comment: 2026-10-04 (owner decision): the courier app is unlisted — not searchable or browsable in either store. docs/runbooks/mobile-release.md § Distribution and age-restricted goods.

distribution.why: Only Northline's couriers use it. Apple: Unlisted App distribution (requested after the first approval; couriers install from the direct link). Google Play: the closed testing track, its testers the couriers' Google Group (Managed Google Play private apps need a managed organisation the couriers' own phones are not in).

ageRestrictedGoods.note: Couriers sell nothing. An age-restricted drop-off shows the age to check and the account holder's name; the courier confirms three answers (photo ID checked, name matches, of age) or gives a reason and returns the order to the business. The app keeps no ID detail.
